why: The properly encoded legacy spellings (`ring%2Baudio`, `haptic%2Baudio`) must keep selecting their cue after the rename to the hyphenated canonical values (issue #497); dropping the alias lookup silently breaks every pre-#497 bookmark.
killedBy: canonicalDevSearch round trips every blockedFire cue, spelled as documented, and the encoded legacy spellings (issue #497)
parseDevFlags: blockedFire values are safe to paste into a query string (issue #497) the properly encoded legacy spellings stay accepted as aliases of the canonical cue
